title: Ward Clerk
description: An exciting opportunity has arisen to join the J42 Urology Ward team as a Ward Clerk, providing essential administrative and clerical support within a busy ward environment. This is an excellent opportunity to become part of a friendly, well-organised, and supportive team that is committed to delivering outstanding patient care and ensuring a positive patient experience. As a Ward Clerk, you will play a key role in supporting patients, relatives, and colleagues throughout their journey on the ward. You will be the first point of contact for the ward, welcoming patients, visitors, and staff in a professional and compassionate manner. You will provide information, guidance, and signposting to ensure individuals receive the support they need. The successful candidate will be highly organised, adaptable, and able to manage a varied workload in a fast-paced environment. You will possess excellent communication and customer service skills, a confident telephone manner, strong IT skills, and the ability to prioritise and switch efficiently between tasks as ward demands change. Accurate record keeping is a fundamental aspect of this role. You will be responsible for maintaining patient and administrative records, ensuring information is up to date, accurate, and recorded in line with Trust policies and procedures. Ward Clerk cover is provided seven days a week between 8:00am and 8:00pm, including weekends and bank holidays, and the successful candidate will be expected to work flexibly across these hours. The Team works closely with the urology consultants to ensure patients are safe, well cared for, and consistently receive a high standard of care. The ward also collaborates with the wider urology departments, offering valuable opportunities for professional development within the speciality. J42 is a welcoming and supportive place to work, known for its positive atmosphere, strong teamwork, and patient centred approach.
